amendments.what: Home/away assignment of certified team rows is done by normalised team code (OAK->LV, SD->LAC, STL->LA) instead of the builder's own 'home' flag.
amendments.why: The certified builder (alpha_engine/features/nfl.py) compares pbp posteam (LA/LAC/LV) with schedule home_team (STL/SD/OAK) and flags NEITHER team as home in 184 games (2010-2019: all STL/SD/OAK home games). Without the fix those games duplicate/drop in the join.
amendments.scope: join key only; the certified column values (including the builder's 'home', 'rest', 'short_rest', 'bye', 'rest_gap' which are wrong for the home team in those 184 games) are used AS BUILT. No test-season game is affected (last affected season 2019).

amendments.what: Moneyline contracts are enumerated from the KXNFLGAME candle files (ticker date + team codes mapped to the schedule; Kalshi 'JAC' = nflverse 'JAX') instead of from horizons rows; kickoff for them = schedule gameday+gametime America/New_York.
amendments.why: The horizons backfill contains no Los Angeles Rams games (its game mapping dropped 'LA'); the candle files cover 280 of 285 2025 games. Spread/total/team-total/1H-total still come from horizons and therefore miss the Rams games (264 games covered).

amendments.what: Added a post-scoring 'diag' stage: settlement agreement computed on non-moneyline rows only (the in-test number mixed in moneyline rows that carry no backfill result) and official settlement vs box-score agreement per family.
amendments.why: Reporting fix only; no model, rule, sigma or selection changed and no test metric was recomputed.

amendments.what: Builder defect fixed upstream; same frozen protocol, same candidates/splits/seeds; the original pre-fix results are kept (report.json, data/). Re-run with a fresh copy of sift-alpha-ops alpha_engine/features/nfl.py + core.py (+ package __init__ files) in WORK/fixed_builder (nfl.py sha256 ef3871dc..., core.py sha256 cd7b4557...), which normalises schedule home/away codes with TEAM_FIX before the join.
amendments.unchanged: protocol.json, baseline, candidate definitions and columns, selection rule, refit scheme, bootstrap (2000, seed 13), situations, price-aware quotes/rules/sigma rule. Validation selection is re-run under the same frozen rule.
amendments.requested_by: study coordinator after the A1 finding
